entities.summary: Edwin B. Miller was an American National Basketball Association (NBA) player. Miller was drafted by the Milwaukee Hawks in the second round of the 1952 NBA draft. Later into the season, Miller was traded to the Baltimore Bullets for George Ratkovicz. Following the Bullets' fold, Miller was drafted in the dispersal draft by the Boston Celtics, but did not play a regular season game with the team.
